workload.description: Discover files for a bounded workspace with overlapping filename patterns.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 in an isolated pinned Socket CLI checkout with requests in a temporary virtual environment at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; local file-discovery assertions passed and marker_probe observed the target region. No external service was called.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises Core.find_files with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
